facts.statement: Shidaisaurus is classified as a metriacanthosaurid dinosaur.
facts.quote: Shidaisaurus is a genus of metriacanthosaurid dinosaur.

facts.statement: The genus Shidaisaurus was described in 2009 by Wu and colleagues.
facts.quote: Shidaisaurus was described in 2009 by Wu and colleagues.

facts.statement: Fossils of Shidaisaurus were found in Early Middle Jurassic rocks of the Chuanjie Formation in Yunnan, China.
facts.quote: Its fossil was found in early Middle Jurassic-age rocks of the Chuanjie Formation in Yunnan, China.

facts.statement: Shidaisaurus was a medium-sized, predatory theropod similar to its relatives.
facts.quote: Based on the known remains, Shidaisaurus was a medium-sized, predatory theropod much like its kin.

facts.statement: The paroccipital process of Shidaisaurus faces down and to the sides, similar to other allosauroids.
facts.quote: The paroccipital process faces down and to the sides, much like other allosauroids.

facts.statement: Shidaisaurus possesses a second cervical vertebra with a tall, sharply pointing epipophysis.
facts.quote: Its second cervical (neck) vertebra, the axis, has a tall and sharply pointing epipophysis.

facts.statement: In Shidaisaurus, the length of the pubis is equal to the height of the iliac blade.
facts.quote: The length of its pubis, when measured from below the front to behind and above, is equal to the height of its iliac blade.

facts.statement: Many dorsal vertebrae of Shidaisaurus lack pleurocoels, a feature attributed to its primitive nature.
facts.quote: Many of its dorsal vertebrae lack the pleurocoels seen in the dorsal vertebrae of related animals, owing to its primitive nature.

facts.statement: A 2016 estimation listed Shidaisaurus as being 7.1 meters long and weighing 950 kilograms.
facts.quote: In 2016 another estimation listed it higher at 7.1 meters (23.3 feet) long and 950 kilograms (2,094 lbs).

facts.statement: Shidaisaurus is the oldest known allosauroid to date.
facts.quote: Es el alosauroide más antiguo conocido hasta la fecha.

facts.statement: Shidaisaurus lived during the Middle Jurassic, approximately 174 million years ago, in what is now Asia.
facts.quote: vivió a mediados del período Jurásico, hace aproximadamente 174 millones de años, durante el Aaleniense, en lo que es hoy Asia.

facts.statement: Fossils of Shidaisaurus were found in Middle Jurassic rocks of the Lufeng Formation in Yunnan, China.
facts.quote: Sus fósiles fueron encontrados en rocas del Jurásico Medio de la Formación Lufeng en Yunnan, China.

facts.statement: Shidaisaurus belongs to the family Metriacanthosauridae.
Shidaisaurus is classified within the subfamily Metriacanthosaurinae.
The time range for Shidaisaurus is estimated between 170.9 and 168.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Bajocian to Bajocian (170.9 to 168.2 million years ago)
